summary: Teck Resources filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a regular quarterly dividend of $0.125 per share on Class A and Class B shares, payable on September 29, 2026 to holders of record September 15, 2026. This is a routine capital return declaration and routine current report by a foreign private issuer. No special situation such as a tender, going-private, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved. The filing contains no deal terms, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no event that would classify it as a special situation.
